original.reason: The finite-stage construction does not produce stable integer coordinates: compatible residues modulo increasing M_N need not have the same least positive representatives. Nor does coordinatewise extraction yield repetition of any B_N. Additionally, imposing agreement with the old block only on its first L_N coordinates does not ensure the old periodicity conditions across the enlarged block. Thus the limiting argument fails.
